institution: UPC — Universitat Politecnica de Catalunya (Manresa School of Engineering, EPSEM)
programme_name: Master's degree in Natural Resources Engineering / Master universitari en Enginyeria dels Recursos Naturals
campus: Escola Politecnica Superior d'Enginyeria de Manresa (EPSEM) — UPC Manresa campus. NOT Barcelona. RUCT centre code 08034679.
boe_order: Acuerdo de Consejo de Ministros 07/10/2016, published BOE 26/10/2016; verificacion 30/04/2015; Resolucion Favorable Acreditacion Institucional 10/09/2024
europe_recognition: EHEA level 7 (Bologna second cycle) — academic recognition across the EHEA. Official 'Master Universitario', ANECA/AQU-evaluated, registered in RUCT at MECES level 3 = EQF/EHEA level 7, carries the Diploma Supplement as of right and gives access to doctoral study. Caveat: EHEA recognition is ACADEMIC recognition; it is not professional recognition for a regulated profession (that runs through Directive 2005/36/EC and a separate national process), and recognition in another EHEA country still requires that country's own recognition procedure — Bologna makes it routine, not automatic.
tuition_eu_eur: EUR 1,162 (2026-27 rates) — 60 ECTS x EUR 19.37/credit (non-habilitante master, 1st enrolment, Decret de preus publics de la Generalitat, Decret 96/2026) = EUR 1,162.20, printed as EUR 1,162 on UPC's own programme page
tuition_non_eu_eur: EUR 2,700 (2026-27 rates) — 60 ECTS x EUR 45.00/credit, the differentiated 1st-enrolment rate for non-EU non-resident master's students approved by UPC's Consell Social. This is the TOTAL, not a surcharge added to the EU price. UPC's own programme page states 'EUR 1,162 (EUR 2,700 for non-EU residents)', confirming the arithmetic.
fees_extra_eur: EUR 218.15 compulsory 'Estudi d'equivalencia de titol d'estudis estrangers per a l'acces als estudis de master' (foreign-degree equivalence study — unavoidable for a Tunisian non-homologated degree) + EUR 30.21 non-refundable application-processing fee per programme applied to + EUR 300 non-refundable advance place-reservation payment on accepting the offer + compulsory academic-record management and learning-support services EUR 69.80 + EUR 70.00 per year (EUR 54.54 + EUR 35.00 per semester if enrolling semesterly; UPC's own FAQ states the bracket as EUR 140-180 per academic year) + EUR 218.15 degree-certificate issuance with Diploma Supplement at the end, plus EUR 90 courier if the certificate must be sent outside the EU. All 2026-27 rates.
language_of_instruction: Spanish — UPC programme page 'Language of instruction: Spanish'; EPSEM's own Spanish page 'Idiomas: Español'. NO English track. Hard filter for a candidate at A0/A1 Spanish.
start_month: February and September (1 academic year, 60 ECTS)
application_window_february: NOT PUBLISHED for this programme. UPC's institution-wide framework (FAQ, primary): spring-semester preinscripcio runs 'de la 1a setmana d'octubre fins a la 1a setmana de desembre' — first week of October to first week of December — with each school free to set its own narrower window inside it. EPSEM publishes no dated February window: its access page says only 'Periodo de preinscripcion abierto' and refers to the academic calendar. A human should confirm dates with EPSEM directly.
places_february: NOT PUBLISHED — UPC states a single combined new-intake figure with no February quota split
complementary_credits_required: 0 (RUCT 4315493: N. Creditos Complementos Formativos = 0). Title-level figure only; the school can still impose complementos on an individual applicant at admission.
notes: CAMPUS: Manresa (EPSEM), not Barcelona — UPC spans four campuses and this is the Manresa one. RUCT CONFLICT — IMPORTANT: UPC's own programme page hyperlinks its 'Official degree' badge to RUCT 4310783, but RUCT marks 4310783 'Publicado en B.O.E. (TITULACION EXTINGUIDA)' with extinction from 21/07/2016 and Creditos Totales 0. The live title is 4315493 (60 ECTS, EPSEM, institutionally re-accredited 10/09/2024), confirmed via ruct.py query 'recursos naturales' and the RUCT detail page. Recorded 4315493; the UPC page's link is stale. FEE ARITHMETIC: 60 x 19.37 = 1,162.20 (EU/resident); 60 x 45.00 = 2,700.00 (non-EU non-resident). FEE CONFLICT 1: UPC's own master's FAQ still quotes 'per a estudiants estrangers no residents ... el preu del credit sera 102,52 EUR'. That figure is stale and contradicted by UPC's own 2026-27 price table (Servei de Gestio Academica), which sets 45.00 EUR/credit for non-EU non-residents, approved by the Consell Social. The 45.00 figure is used. FEE CONFLICT 2: EPSEM's own page quotes 'Precio aproximado del master, 1.600 EUR (3.200 EUR para no residentes a la UE)'. That is UPC's all-in ESTIMATE (tuition plus compulsory admin fees), not the credit-price total; the two are consistent once the ~EUR 140-180/yr admin fees and the EUR 300 advance are added to EUR 2,700. Both recorded. RESIDENCY: Catalonia's Decret 96/2026 art. 1.5 states a long-stay study authorisation does NOT confer resident status, so this candidate stays on the 45.00 EUR/credit rate for the whole degree; enrolling and living in Barcelona does not escape it. 300-ECTS QUESTION: UPC's central rule (FAQ + Academic requirements page, both primary) is that a non-EHEA degree needs NO homologation — UPC itself verifies the level is equivalent and that the degree gives master's access in the awarding country. NOTE a contradiction: EPSEM's own documentation list for foreign graduates asks for the access degree 'con la correspondiente homologacion'. CONFLICT — logged, not resolved. Ministry 'equivalencia de notas medias' declaration is separately required. SPRING ADMISSION RULE: for masters with a spring-term intake, conditionally admitted students are definitively admitted if they hold the bachelor's degree by 28 February — relevant to a February start. SUITABILITY: none of the nine target fields; Spanish-only; recorded for completeness, not as a match.

language_of_instruction: Spanish & English (camins.upc.edu factsheet, verbatim 'Language: Spanish & English'). UPC's central page declines to state one language and says 'Check the language of instruction for each subject in the course guide'; the course guide marks a number of individual subjects 'This subject is taught in English'. So: a mixed-language programme, NOT a fully English-taught one. Do not read the English webpage as evidence of English delivery.
start_month: February and September (1.5 academic years, 90 ECTS)
application_window_february: PUBLISHED AND UNUSUALLY NARROW — for the spring semester of 2026-27 (studies beginning February 2027) Camins publishes for Structural & Construction Engineering: application period 07/10/2026 - 21/10/2026, pre-enrolment fee / Selection 1 deadline 21/10/2026, individual notification within 15 days of the deadline, results published 22/01/2027. That is a TWO-WEEK window, far narrower than the UPC framework ('1a setmana d'octubre fins a la 1a setmana de desembre') and narrower than the sibling Civil Engineering master's 30/09/2026 - 11/11/2026 (results 16/12/2026) in the same table. Only two Camins masters accept a February 2027 start at all: Civil Engineering and this one.
places_total: 45 (camins.upc.edu factsheet and UPC programme page agree)

But applicant-level bridging IS explicit here: for a degree outside the listed civil/industrial/architecture families 'the Academic Committee ... will assess the applicant's curriculum in order to grant them access and establish the necessary bridging courses'. A software-engineering degree falls in that 'Other studies' bucket, so complementos are a real risk for this candidate despite the RUCT zero.
notes: CAMPUS: Barcelona (ETSECCPB/Camins, Campus Diagonal Nord). ECTS CONFLICT: camins.upc.edu's own factsheet says 'Study load: 120 ECTS (including the Master's Final Thesis)' while www.upc.edu says 90 ECTS and RUCT 4315509 gives Creditos Totales 90 (22.5 obligatorios + 37.5 optativos + 30 TFM). ADMISSION: weighted formula published — academic record 40%, efficiency (credits passed / credits enrolled) 30%, similarity of prior curriculum 20%, professional experience and CV 10%. SUITABILITY: none of the nine target fields; civil/structural engineering, and the specific-requirements list does not include computing degrees. Recorded for completeness, not as a match. Stale and contradicted by UPC's own 2026-27 price table (Servei de Gestio Academica), which sets 45.00 EUR/credit for non-EU non-residents, approved by the Consell Social; 45.00 is used and matches the totals printed on each programme page. RESIDENCY: Catalonia's Decret 96/2026 art. 1.5 states a long-stay study authorisation does NOT confer resident status, so this candidate stays on 45.00 EUR/credit for the whole degree — moving to Catalonia does not escape it. 300-ECTS / ACCESS: UPC's central rule (FAQ + Academic requirements page, both primary) is that a non-EHEA degree needs NO homologation — UPC itself verifies the level is equivalent and that the degree gives master's access in the awarding country; a Ministry 'equivalencia de notas medias' declaration is separately required. SPRING ADMISSION RULE: for masters with a spring-term intake, conditionally admitted students become definitively admitted if they hold the bachelor's degree by 28 February.

start_month: February and September (1 academic year, 60 ECTS)
application_window_february: NOT PUBLISHED. The MAMME site publishes only the September round — for the 2026-27 September intake: applications 28/01/2026 - 10/05/2026, selection decision communicated by 01/06/2026, provisional list 01/06/2026, final list 04/06/2026. No February/Q2 window is dated anywhere on the programme site, even though 3 February places exist. UPC's framework window (FAQ, primary) applies by default: '1a setmana d'octubre fins a la 1a setmana de desembre'. The MAMME page also says an official degree certificate is required 'the day of registration, in September', which reads as if the programme treats September as the normal entry point. A human must confirm with the FME whether the 3 February places are actually opened.
places_total: 33 — UPC programme page verbatim: 'New intake places 30 (September) and 3 (February)'
places_february: 3 — one of the smallest published February quotas at UPC (compare Management Engineering 20, MET 20, MATT 20, MEE 20, MASTEAM 10). Three places against 30 in September makes the February route a marginal proposition here, not a real second door.
complementary_credits_required: NOT PUBLISHED IN RUCT (RUCT 4312408 shows Creditos Totales 0 and no complementos row — this older title's credit breakdown is simply not published in the register). Applicant-level rule IS published by the programme: 'A minimum of 60 ECTS in mathematics courses is recommended. Candidates whose mathematical background is insufficient can be accepted provided they take additional courses, up to 30 ECTS, to reach the required level.' For a 300-ECTS software-engineering graduate this is the operative constraint — up to 30 ECTS of bridging maths, which would push the real cost above the 60-ECTS figure.
notes: CAMPUS: Barcelona (FME, Campus Diagonal Sud) — not Terrassa, Castelldefels or Manresa. RUCT code 4312408 matches the input hint and is confirmed both from the 'Official degree' link on UPC's own page and from the RUCT detail page; ruct.py confirms estado 'Publicado en B.O.E. (TITULACION RENOVADA)'. FEE ARITHMETIC: 60 x 19.37 = 1,162.20 (EU/resident); 60 x 45.00 = 2,700.00 (non-EU non-resident). NOTE: bridging maths courses (up to 30 ECTS) would be charged on top at the same 45.00 EUR/credit — up to EUR 1,350 extra. FIT: closest thing in this batch to the candidate's fields (path AB). Explicitly welcomes 'graduates in engineering or applied sciences'. Focus proposals include 'Optimization and Operation Research for Efficient Decision Making' and 'Mathematical and Computational Modelling with PDEs'. Selection on academic record, CV, statement of purpose and possibly an interview. Up to 22.5 ECTS may be taken in other UPC master's programmes, which is a route into data-science or statistics coursework. FUNDING: MAMME holds the AGAUR 'International Master's Programme' (IMP) mention. The Fundacio Ferran Sunyer Balaguer offers 2 tuition grants for this master but the page states these are 'per als estudiants locals' — NOT open to this candidate. FEE CONFLICT: UPC's own master's FAQ still quotes 102,52 EUR/credit for non-EU non-residents. Stale and contradicted by UPC's 2026-27 price table (Servei de Gestio Academica), which sets 45.00 EUR/credit approved by the Consell Social; 45.00 is used and matches the total printed on the programme page. RESIDENCY: Catalonia's Decret 96/2026 art. 1.5 — a long-stay study authorisation does NOT confer resident status, so this candidate stays on 45.00 EUR/credit for the whole degree. ACCESS: UPC's central rule is that a non-EHEA degree needs NO homologation; UPC verifies equivalence itself. A Ministry 'equivalencia de notas medias' declaration is separately required. SPRING ADMISSION RULE: conditionally admitted students on a spring-intake master become definitively admitted if they hold the bachelor's degree by 28 February.
